# IconButton

A square icon button with a transparent background, a tooltip and an accessible name.

**Interaction**: hover and press add the shared state layer (press darkens immediately and recovers 120 ms
after release, without scaling); `Tab` focus shows the focus ring, and `Enter` / `Space` trigger the button;
`active` is the pressed state of a toggle button (subtle accent background); when disabled, the opacity is
lowered and there is no state layer, and with `disabledReason` the reason is shown on hover or focus.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Secondary actions in toolbars and list items (refresh, more, download, close); accent style for Send

## Import

```ts
import { IconButton } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

`label` is required: it is the tooltip and the accessible name.

```tsx
import { IconButton, Inline } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={1}>
      <IconButton icon="refresh" label="Refresh" />
      <IconButton icon="download" label="Download" />
      <IconButton icon="more" label="More" />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Variants and sizes

`soft` suits places that need a visible boundary; `accent` is for main actions such as sending; `active` is the
pressed state of a toggle button.

```tsx
import { IconButton, Inline } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Variants() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={2}>
      <IconButton icon="grid" label="Grid view" variant="soft" active />
      <IconButton icon="list" label="List view" variant="soft" />
      <IconButton icon="send" label="Send" variant="accent" size="lg" />
      <IconButton icon="close" label="Remove" size="sm" />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## States

### Disabled reason

When a button is disabled because of permissions or unmet conditions, explain why with `disabledReason`: hover
or keyboard focus shows "label: reason".

```tsx
import { IconButton, Inline } from 'vellum-ui'

export function DisabledReason() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={1}>
      <IconButton
        icon="download"
        label="Download"
        disabled
        disabledReason="You do not have permission to download"
      />
      <IconButton icon="trash" label="Delete" disabled />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `IconName` | Icon name. | — | Yes |
| `label` | `string` | Text label, used as the tooltip and the accessible name (required: an icon button must be understandable). | — | Yes |
| `variant` | `'ghost' \| 'soft' \| 'accent'` | `accent`: solid accent color (such as Send); `ghost`: transparent background (default); `soft`: neutral fill. | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Size: `sm` inside list items, `md` in toolbars, `lg` for the primary action next to an input (such as Send). | — | No |
| `tooltip` | `boolean` | Whether to show the tooltip on hover; shown by default. | — | No |
| `active` | `boolean` | Pressed state (for toggle buttons). | — | No |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Disabled reason: while `disabled`, hover or keyboard focus shows "label: reason", such as "You don't have permission to download". With a reason, the button can still be focused with `Tab` (`aria-disabled`), screen readers read the reason through `aria-describedby`, and clicks and `Enter` have no effect; the reason is shown even with `tooltip={false}`. | — | No |

Also accepts the attributes of the native element (`ButtonHTMLAttributes`), such as `disabled` and `onClick`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

Values: `"search"`, `"link"`, `"at"`, `"sort"`, `"filter"`, `"user"`, `"sparkles"`, `"file-text"`, `"activity"`, `"aperture"`, `"archive"`, `"arrow-left"`, `"arrow-down"`, `"arrow-right"`, `"arrow-up"`, `"ban"`, `"banknote"`, `"bell"`, `"bell-off"`, `"book"`, `"bot"`, `"braces"`, `"brain"`, `"briefcase"`, `"building"`, `"calendar"`, `"chart"`, `"check"`, `"chevron-down"`, `"chevron-left"`, `"chevron-right"`, `"alert"`, `"check-circle"`, `"circle-dashed"`, `"x-circle"`, `"approval"`, `"clock"`, `"code"`, `"columns"`, `"command"`, `"contact"`, `"copy"`, `"enter"`, `"crown"`, `"database"`, `"download"`, `"more"`, `"external-link"`, `"file-image"`, `"eye"`, `"eye-off"`, `"folder"`, `"grip"`, `"folder-open"`, `"project"`, `"handshake"`, `"hard-drive"`, `"hash"`, `"home"`, `"hourglass"`, `"image"`, `"images"`, `"inbox"`, `"info"`, `"kanban"`, `"key"`, `"finance"`, `"layers"`, `"dashboard"`, `"grid"`, `"list"`, `"loader"`, `"lock"`, `"logout"`, `"message"`, `"messages"`, `"monitor"`, `"move"`, `"moon"`, `"org"`, `"package"`, `"rows"`, `"palette"`, `"sidebar"`, `"attach"`, `"edit"`, `"pin"`, `"pin-start"`, `"pin-end"`, `"plus"`, `"power"`, `"receipt"`, `"refresh"`, `"reply"`, `"rotate-ccw"`, `"scan-search"`, `"send"`, `"settings"`, `"share"`, `"shield"`, `"smile"`, `"compose"`, `"star"`, `"stop"`, `"sun"`, `"thumbs-down"`, `"thumbs-up"`, `"trash"`, `"truck"`, `"undo"`, `"upload"`, `"user-minus"`, `"user-plus"`, `"users"`, `"wallet"`, `"webhook"`, `"close"`, `"zap"`
